args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 2026-06-09 10:48 AM. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
